summary: Every reproducible number in the plan re-ran to the planner's exact figures, and the change is a visible, on-brand, reversible re-rank of the in-app welcome header that leads with the create invitation and demotes the 'code is on its way / check your spam / while you wait' block - fresh-by-mechanism ground on the step that gates the 89% in-app review engine, breaking no promise, exchange, or owner rejection. Its causal story (the code-status block repels warm users at first paint) is an unprovable bet the data cannot confirm and the plan says so, but the fix is asymmetric - removing a literal 'go check your email' instruction and leading with the invitation that historically moved this funnel cannot lower role-selection - so a wrong cause does not make it harmful, which is exactly the small compounding bet this process exists to ship.

findings.issue: The assumed cause (the loud code-status/'check your spam'/'while you wait' block acts as a competing exit CTA driving the fast <=6s exits) is under-determined, not established - and the plan's own segmentation cuts weakly the other way: claim-forwarded users who SEE the block pick a role at 63% (38/60) vs 44% (14/32) for non-claim users who never see it.
findings.evidence: Re-ran node tools/significance.mjs 14 32 38 60 -> +19.6pts, p=0.071, NOT SIGNIFICANT. A <=6s zero-interaction exit is equally consistent with a pure video-interest ceiling; ANALYTICS.md confirms the instruments are blind between paint and role-select, so nothing can separate the two at this traffic. This is NOT a reject-level contradiction: the 63>44 gap is confounded by intent (claim users already paid the email price) and is itself non-significant, so it shows the block is not catastrophic, not that it helps. The plan foregrounds this exact limitation (diagnosis.what_it_cannot_distinguish, cause_verification.against) rather than hiding it, and rests its case on the fix being asymmetric, which holds.
findings.required_fix: None required to build. Keep the stated commitment: measurable:false, and never claim it 'worked' without a SIGNIFICANT tools/significance.mjs result on the from_claim-segmented in-app funnel. If it re-measures flat, the honest read is 'a video-interest ceiling', not a copy failure.

findings.issue: The absolute prize is tiny and permanently unmeasurable at this traffic (~1-2 extra review clicks/fortnight against 19 review clicks/30d and ~60 claim arrivals/fortnight).
findings.evidence: Confirmed 30d review clicks = 19 total (in_app thankyou 17, preview 1, share 1, email_redirect 0) via node tools/funnel-report.mjs 30 --until=2026-08-01. Any swing under ~13-20pts is invisible at this volume (FUNNEL_CHANGELOG noise floor). The plan labels this honestly and does not dress it as a measurable experiment; the changelog explicitly blesses shipping such unprovable compounding bets, so this is not a blocker.
findings.required_fix: None. Do not upgrade the language to a testable claim; leave it as the labelled compounding bet it is.
